hits.title: Why Archer Aviation stock surged 22% as Boeing deal expands its defense and autonomous flight business.
hits.snippet: [acquires | 2026-08-10] Archer was planning to acquire Wisk on Aug 10th '26. The three businesses Archer is buying are Wisk Aero, SkyGrid and Insitu.

hits.snippet: [acquires] Archer is planning to acquire Wisk. Archer has announced a deal to acquire three businesses from Boeing - Wisk, Insitu and SkyGrid - in a transaction that will see Boeing take a strategic equity stake in Archer and deepen collaboration between the two companies.

hits.title: Wisk Aero Acquires Leading Software Firm Verocel
hits.snippet: [acquires | 2024-06-25] Wisk Aero LLC. acquired Verocel, Inc. on Jun 25th '24. Wisk Aero, a leading Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) company, announced today it has acquired Verocel Inc., a software verification and validation (V&V) company.
